== Title ==
<span lang="ja">行き止まり</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-232o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">３フォース消費して、場の相手の側に配備する。相手の戦士の配備コストはすべて＋１される。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">帝国軍の兵員は、逃亡者を分断し、立ち往生させる戦術を取った。ルークとレイアが切り抜けるには、勇気と大胆な行動力が必要だ。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Dead End.

'''Card text:''' Use 3 Force to deploy on your opponent's side of the table. All of your opponent's warriors are deploy +1.

'''Lore:''' Imperial troopers used tactics that separated fugitives and left them stranded. Luke and Leia would need courage and bold action to get through.

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 3
* '''Printed subtype:''' Effect
* '''Uniqueness:''' Unique (one marker)<ref name="jp-face" />
